kind: measurement snapshot — two independently produced rasters, pinned for the #1024 lockup regression test
toleranceRationale: At 720 px/em one raster pixel is 0.00139 em. Independent capture/render/crop pipelines (device-pixel rounding, edge anti-aliasing, a 24/255 ink threshold) cost a pixel or two, and the measured axis spread of this pair reaches 0.0102 em (ermine aspect). The assertion tolerance is 0.02 em (14.4 px, about 0.23 pt at the PDF word's 11.568 pt) — an honest noise floor, not a claim that every axis is ≤ 0.00114 em. The withdrawn 0.076 em ermine lift fails it by nearly 4×.
